task.title: Modifying the allocation of a vacation pay that is paid because of a layoff or separation

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if monies other than vacation pay were paid on separation:

ul.li: If no, go to step 2.
If yes, refer to Modifying the allocation of monies on separation . Modifying the allocation of monies on separation

step.cmd: Determine if the allocation starts from the last week worked:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 3.
If no, go to step 5.

step.cmd: Determine if the ELWW are less than the NWE:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 4.
If no, go to step 5.

step.cmd: Determine the amount to allocate as follows:

ul.li: Subtract the ELWW from the NWE. The result is the amount to allocate in that week.
Subtract the result from the total vacation pay.
Divide the balance of the vacation pay by the NWE. The result is the number of weeks of allocation at the NWE.
Take the number of full weeks of allocation and multiply that number by the NWE.
Subtract that total from the total amount of vacation pay.
The balance is allocated on the last week.
Go to step 6.

step.cmd: Determine the amount to allocate when the ELWW are equal to or greater than the NWE or when the allocation starts later in the BP using the following formula:

ul.li: Divide the vacation pay by the NWE. The result is the number of weeks of allocation.
Multiply the number of full weeks of allocation by the NWE.
Subtract that total from the total amount of vacation pay.
The balance is allocated on the last week.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim for benefits is active, terminated, blocked or archived:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 7.

If the claim is terminated, but may be reactivated:
Under the Dormant tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Select Reactivate .
Go to step 7.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 16.

step.cmd: Determine if an original BP extension must be modified. For moreinformation, refer to Modifying a benefit period extension due to an earnings allocation — Renewal or continuing claim and go to step 8.
In FTS, select the Payments tab and determine if the ELWW need to be modified:
On the Allocations tab, determine if an allocation type W - Earnings week 1 is displayed for the week to be modified:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 10.
If no, go to step 12.

step.cmd: Determine if the earnings to be modified for that week are higher than the amount of earnings indicated in the Earnings Week 1 field:
Select the Allocations (M175) transaction to input the A - Amended earnings allocation as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

On the first line, do the following:
Type: Select A - Amended earnings .
Amount: Enter the modified ELWW amount.
Start date: Enter the week of the W - Earnings week 1 allocation.
End date: Enter the week of the W - Earnings week 1 allocation.
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 6 - Earnings other than declared .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .
Go to step 13.

step.cmd: On the Payments tab, select the appropriate Report week and modify the claimant’s report as follows: *Change only the information that requires modification.

ul.li: Select Modify . Note
Earnings: For each week, enter the client’s earnings if necessary.

Full work week: Select the appropriate option:
1 - Full work week - week 1
2 - Full work week - week 2
3 - Full work week both weeks
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .

Message: Select the appropriate option:
If ELWW were reported on the claimant’s report and must be modified, select 6 - Earnings other than declared .
If ELWW were not reported on the claimant’s report and must be added, select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .
Select Save .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine what corrections must be input. Modify the allocation as follows:

info.p: Example: Modifying the allocation when the ELWW are less than the NWE
Example: Modifying the allocation when the ELWW are equal to or greater than the NWE

step.cmd: Under the Summary tab, determine if there is a stop pay related to these earnings and do one of the following:

ul.li: If no, go to step 15.

If yes, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and remove the stop payment as follows:
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Manual Action: Select the appropriate MA .
Rescind: Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if a blocked claim must also be modified:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 16.
If no, go to step 32.

step.cmd: Determine if an original BP extension must be modified. For more information, refer to Modifying a benefit period extension due to an earnings allocation — Renewal or continuing claim and go to step 17.
Determine the blocked claim’s CS by reviewing the Blocked Status column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed, go to step 18.
If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 6.
If any other CS is displayed, go to step 28.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 19.
If all rows are blank, go to step 21.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter [the next business day].

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return step 19.
If all rows are blank, go to step 21.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised (or 2 - Renewal , if necessary).
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
To complete the registration number, select C - Yes .
To leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions, select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Under the Allocations tab, rescind the original allocation as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Rescind .
Type: Select V - Vacation pay only .
Amount: Leave this field blank.
Start Date: Enter the start date of the allocation you are rescinding.
End Date: Leave this field blank.
Last week amount: Leave this field blank.
Detection: Select the detection code used to establish the allocation.
Infraction: Select the infraction code used to establish the allocation.
Message: Select the message code used to establish the allocation, or the appropriate message code.
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine which of the following situations applies:
Input the new allocation as follows:
Input the new allocation as follows:
Under the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 27.
If the transaction shown is correct, select Close and go to step 32.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 23.

step.cmd: Determine if an original BP extension must be modified. For more information, refer to Modifying a benefit period extension due to an earnings allocation — Renewal or continuing claim and go to step 29.
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Select Memo (MPS) .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 32 - Your vacation/holiday pay was not deducted .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the vacation pay.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .
Remarks line 4: Enter the information about the BP extension, if necessary.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC, as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send a D-20-16-03 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Amending allocation (2442): Select the appropriate option:
Amending allocation - new information received from client
Amending allocation - new information received from another source
Date previous letter sent (1064)

Allocations of Earnings (2516): Select the appropriate option:
Allocation of earnings - Only from ROE #1 - Monies allocated beyond BPC
Allocation of earnings - Monies allocated beyond BPC are from both ROE #1 + ROE #2

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
